svg.aria-label: Global Fan Platform. TypeScript · Next.js · Supabase · OpenAI API. May 2026. Full-stack platform for live events like the World Cup and Olympics: event feeds, communities, trip planning, and a real-time speech-to-speech translator chaining Whisper → GPT → TTS.
